comparables.method: Same-area high-rise asking-rent listings already in real_projects.json, excluding Angkasapuri low-cost flats. Duplicate ads that appear under more than one KL Gateway / Suezcap Brickz record are counted once. Preferred band is ±15% of the typ size when at least 5 listings exist; otherwise the band is widened to ±20% then ±25% until at least 5 (or 4 at ±25%).
comparables.excluded: Taman Bukit Angkasa (Angkasapuri Flat) and Taman Bukit Angkasa (Taman Angkasapuri Flat) — low-cost flats, rent psf ~1.88, not used as comps for these new launches.
comparables.area_project_median_note: Median of each completed non-flat Bangsar South project’s own rent_psf_median (n=13). The earlier 3.64 figure included the two Angkasapuri flats.

net_yield_method.note: Same method as the live map: net = gross − vacancy (1/12 of gross) − assessment (4% of annual rent) − maintenance (RM/psf/month × size × 12 ÷ price) − quit rent & insurance (RM250/year ÷ price). For Aviera, maintenance uses the published RM0.50 psf (The Edge, 19–25 Oct 2026), inclusive of sinking fund. For River Park, no published fee was found, so the map’s Bangsar South assumption of RM0.35 psf is used and labelled as an assumption.

260.note: Size-band samples are too few (need at least 4 listings within ±25%). Headline yield uses the area project-median rent psf instead, and is flagged.
